crosswalk.numbering_statement: The shared episode is not aligned by equal chapter number. Griffith explicitly omits his Cantos XXVIII and XXIX and resumes with Canto XXX; the GRETIL carrier places Hanuman's deliberation at sarga 28.

adjacent_sequence_check.episode: Sita sees the speaker and questions the encounter

ordered_alignment_anchors.shared_event: Hanuman observes Sita and the guards, then begins sustained deliberation.
He recognizes that he has found Sita and completed the reconnaissance part of his mission.
He decides that leaving without consoling or speaking to Sita could endanger her and leave Rama without her message.
He considers language, appearance, and the risk that Sita may mistake him for Ravana.
He anticipates alarm, intervention by the guards, capture or death, and failure of the wider mission.
He compares the harm of speaking badly with the harm of remaining silent and seeks a way to avoid both.
He chooses a truthful, reassuring opening centred on Rama before revealing himself more directly.

crosswalk.alignment_boundary: The ordered event correspondence across the Sanskrit transcription, Griffith translation, and visually reviewed Dutt scan supports an episode-level crosswalk. It does not prove line-by-line translation identity, identical recensions, or the correctness of one numbering system over the other.

title.hi: सीता से बोलने से पहले हनुमान का विचार

story.en: Hidden in the grove, Hanuman does not speak immediately. He considers Sita's distress, what Rama needs him to learn, how his form and language may be understood, and what could happen if the guards are alerted. He then chooses a gentle, truthful opening connected with Rama so that reassurance can come before further disclosure.
story.hi: वाटिका में छिपे हनुमान तुरंत नहीं बोलते। वे सीता की व्यथा, राम के लिए आवश्यक संदेश, अपने रूप और भाषा के सम्भावित अर्थ, तथा राक्षसी पहरेदारों के सचेत होने के परिणाम पर विचार करते हैं। फिर वे राम से जुड़ी सत्य और मधुर बात से आरम्भ करने का निर्णय लेते हैं, ताकि आगे बढ़ने से पहले विश्वास और आश्वासन बन सके।

lenses.en: Before acting, name the real purpose and the person who most needs care; speed is not useful if it defeats the purpose.
lenses.hi: कार्य से पहले वास्तविक उद्देश्य और उस व्यक्ति को पहचानें जिसकी सुरक्षा या सहायता सबसे अधिक आवश्यक है; यदि जल्दबाज़ी उद्देश्य को ही बिगाड़ दे तो वह उपयोगी नहीं है।
lenses.application_boundary: A reflective prompt, not a command to delay urgent help.

lenses.en: Choose truthful language that the listener can safely receive. Audience awareness can improve communication, but it never authorizes deception or manipulation.
lenses.hi: ऐसी सत्य भाषा चुनें जिसे सामने वाला सुरक्षित रूप से ग्रहण कर सके। श्रोता का ध्यान रखना संवाद को बेहतर बना सकता है, पर छल या नियंत्रण को उचित नहीं बनाता।
lenses.application_boundary: Do not conceal danger, consent, material facts, or power.

lenses.en: Consider not only the intended effect but also fear, misunderstanding, escalation, and the wider consequences if the first move goes badly.
lenses.hi: केवल इच्छित परिणाम ही नहीं, बल्कि भय, गलतफहमी, तनाव बढ़ने और पहला कदम बिगड़ने पर व्यापक परिणामों पर भी विचार करें।
lenses.application_boundary: This is qualitative reflection, not a causal forecast or guarantee.

lenses.en: When several options carry risk, begin with the smallest truthful step that can build trust and reveal whether it is safe to continue.
lenses.hi: जब कई विकल्प जोखिमपूर्ण हों, तो उस छोटे और सत्य कदम से आरम्भ करें जो विश्वास बना सके और यह बता सके कि आगे बढ़ना सुरक्षित है या नहीं।
lenses.application_boundary: A reversible first step is not enough when urgent protection or qualified help is required.
